# Attempt 6 scope: F1 is fixed in this ticket

Ruud's decision after the return from the attempt 5 review: F1 (a test-only
change under packages/core/src is never mutated) is fixed in SEEN-116, not
split into a follow-up. Criterion 3 says packages/core changes, and a change
that only weakens the tests of a source file is one.

What the fix has to establish, for the solution record to plan as one slice:

- A slice entry naming a test file under packages/core/src (`<x>.test.ts`)
  is measured over the source it tests: its sibling `<x>.ts` when that
  exists, otherwise the test's directory. mutation.source_files() and the
  gate's _require_mutation both apply that mapping, so a slice that names only
  a test still needs a measurement at or above the floor.
- mutation_ci.select() applies the same mapping to changed test files, so
  CI mutates the source a changed test covers instead of skipping the job.
  test_only_test_files_select_nothing is replaced by the mapping test.
- One mapping function, shared by both, so the gate and CI cannot disagree.

The lows ride along without a slice: F3 (the report says not applicable only
when not_applicable is true, and a failed run says so) if it fits the cap,
otherwise it is named in the Outcome; F4 (record the attempt 5 CI run as a
check, or drop the figure from the Outcome); F2 and F5 need nothing.
